items.question: What partnerships does JVTO hold?
items.answer: JVTO is partnered with ISIC (student identity card programme), HPWKI (local volcanic tourism industry body), and INDECON (ecotourism network). Details and proof links are on this page.

items.question: Is health screening on Ijen mandatory?
items.answer: Yes. Health screening is mandatory and non-negotiable for Ijen night hike routes. The system checks SpO2, blood pressure, resting heart rate, and respiratory history. No valid QR code means no access to the crater zone.

items.question: What is the cancellation policy in brief?
items.answer: Cancellations 48+ hours before Day 1 convert to 100% JVTO Package Credit (non-expiring, transferable). Cancellations under 48 hours are fully forfeited. Cash refunds are not available. Full policy: /policy/booking-payment-cancellation.

items.question: Does JVTO mix strangers into one vehicle?
items.answer: No. JVTO runs private tours only. Your vehicle and crew are allocated exclusively for your booking.

items.question: What does the ISIC partnership mean for students?
items.answer: JVTO offers student-focused pricing on selected tours for verified ISIC cardholders. Details and eligibility are at /isic/student-package.
